title: Demo reset: add safety rails to prevent non-demo tenant resets + rate limit reset actions
author: Devon Price
release_notes: Internal-only: harden demo tenant reset tooling with environment guards, explicit confirmation, and rate limits to reduce blast radius + prevent accidental resets.
description:
Context
We’ve had a few near-misses and one confirmed incident where the internal reset tooling was invoked from the wrong shell context / with stale env vars, resulting in a reset call being constructed against a non-demo org. Additionally, during live demos and dry runs we’ve seen multiple reset requests fired in quick succession (double-clicks, retries, Slack copy/paste), spiking control-plane load and leading to 429s in adjacent workflows.

This PR adds two things:
1) Safety rails to make it effectively impossible to reset a non-demo tenant.
2) Rate limits + idempotency semantics around reset actions to prevent repeated resets in a short window.

What changed (high-level)
- Added a server-side “demo tenant guard” check that must pass for any reset operation (CLI + API).
- Introduced a dedicated permission for reset execution (separate from general admin) and ensured it’s audited.
- Added a reset action rate limiter (token bucket) keyed by org_id + actor_id.
- Added request idempotency (Idempotency-Key header) for reset endpoints.
- Hardened the CLI with explicit confirmations and “environment fingerprint” verification.
- Updated the demo healthcheck report to surface rate limit state + last reset metadata.

Safety rails (server-side)
- New org attribute `org.flags.demo_tenant=true` must be present AND org slug must match `demo-*`.
  - Rationale: slug check catches accidental flag propagation; flag check avoids slug collisions.
- Reset endpoint now rejects any org not meeting the guard with HTTP 403 and an error code `DEMO_RESET_GUARD_FAILED`.
- Added allowlist support for emergency cases (single org_id list in config) but default is empty and requires on-call override.

Safety rails (CLI)
- `rw demo reset` now requires:
  - `--org` OR `--project` but resolves to org_id deterministically and prints it.
  - an interactive confirmation containing the org slug (e.g., type: `reset demo-acme-sbx`), unless `--non-interactive` is set.
  - when `--non-interactive` is set, requires `--confirm-org-slug=<slug>` (prevents CI jobs from blasting the wrong tenant).
- CLI now prints an “environment fingerprint” (control plane URL + account + org_id) before it sends the request.

Rate limiting + idempotency
- Reset endpoint now enforces:
  - 1 reset / 5 minutes / org_id
  - burst of 2 within 30 seconds / actor_id (to allow “oops, rerun” but avoid spam)
- 429 responses include `Retry-After` and a clear message tailored for SEs.
- Added `Idempotency-Key` support so retries from the CLI don’t create multiple resets.

Auditability / permissions
- New permission `demo.reset.execute` required for API calls.
- All reset attempts (pass/fail) write to audit log with:
  - actor_id, org_id, org_slug, reason (if provided), guard decision, rate limit decision, idempotency key

Changed areas/files
- control plane:
  - api/reset_controller.ts (guard + rate limit + idempotency)
  - services/demo_reset_guard.ts (org eligibility logic)
  - services/rate_limit.ts (reset limiter wiring)
  - auth/permissions.ts (new permission)
  - audit/audit_events.ts (new event type: DEMO_RESET_ATTEMPT)
- cli:
  - cli/commands/demo/reset.ts (confirmation + fingerprint)
  - cli/http/idempotency.ts (header helper)
- docs/runbooks:
  - docs/internal/demo/reset.md (updated flags + error handling)

Testing
- Unit tests:
  - demo reset guard: flagged vs unflagged orgs; slug mismatch; allowlist path
  - rate limiter: org-based window; actor burst
  - idempotency: same key returns same reset action id
- Integration tests:
  - e2e reset happy path on demo org
  - reset rejected on non-demo org
  - consecutive resets produce 429 with Retry-After
- Manual:
  - Verified CLI interactive flow + non-interactive flags in a staging sandbox

Rollout
- This is gated behind `features.demo_reset_safety_rails` (default ON in demo env; OFF elsewhere until next week).
- Once we confirm no regressions in demo tenant operations, we can enable globally for all environments.

Follow-ups
- ENG-4879: route rate limit metrics to demo alerting dashboards
- ENG-4894: align parallel demo namespaces with per-project reset semantics (today rate limit is per-org)

Notes
- This does not change customer-facing APIs. Reset endpoints are internal-only and require privileged auth.
- Error messaging is intentionally SE-friendly (actionable + suggests healthcheck / Retry-After).
commits: control-plane: add demo reset guard + explicit error codes
control-plane: implement reset rate limiting + idempotency key handling
auth/audit: add demo.reset.execute permission and audit log event
cli: require explicit confirmation / fingerprint for demo resets
tests: guard + limiter + idempotency coverage; integration tests
docs: update internal demo reset runbook with new flags and troubleshooting
review_conversation:
Ethan Park (requested changes): The server-side guard needs to be authoritative; CLI checks are good but can’t be the only line of defense. Also please ensure the permission is separate from org admin and the audit event logs failures too.

Devon Price (author): Agreed. Pushed a commit that makes the guard mandatory in the API handler and adds `demo.reset.execute` permission + audit logging for both allowed and rejected attempts.

Sean Gallagher (requested changes): Rate limit windows look reasonable, but make sure 429 includes Retry-After and that the healthcheck surfaces “last reset” so SEs can self-diagnose. Also confirm we don’t accidentally rate limit healthcheck.

Devon Price (author): Added Retry-After header + human-readable message and updated demo healthcheck output to include last reset timestamp/action id + current limiter state. Healthcheck path is unaffected.

Allison Grant (comment): Please export metrics for guard rejects and rate limit hits; can be follow-up but at least add TODO + event tags.

Devon Price (author): Added tags to the audit event and a TODO referencing ENG-4879 for dashboarding/alerts.

Markus Klein (approval): CLI UX looks good for SE workflow. Confirmed the non-interactive flags will work in our runbook automation.

Ethan Park (approval): Looks solid. Thanks for adding the allowlist override with empty default + config-only.

Sean Gallagher (approval): Approved; aligns with demo incident learnings from SUP-4127.
notes_for_release_manager: No external release impact. Internal demo operations only. Enable `features.demo_reset_safety_rails` in non-demo envs after one week of validation.
